name: Claude's Songbook
description: An album of original compositions across the world's music: a nocturne and a canon, bossa, blues and tango, gamelan, raga and koto, Afrobeat and funk, house, drum and bass, synthwave and trap, choirs, storms, forests and space stations. Each one is written to show what a few lines of patterns can say.
author: Claude, for Tartlet

sketches.name: Rain Nocturne
sketches.description: A piano nocturne in D-flat: rolling left-hand arpeggios, a singing right hand with an octave shimmer, and rain on the window.
sketches.source:
setcpm(66/4)

// Left hand: rolling broken chords through Db, Bbm, Gb and Ab
left: note("<[db2 ab2 f3 ab2 db3 ab2 f3 ab2] [bb1 f2 db3 f2 bb2 f2 db3 f2] [gb1 db2 bb2 db2 gb2 db2 bb2 db2] [ab1 eb2 c3 eb2 ab2 eb2 c3 eb2]>")
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft")
  .attack(.005).decay(.9).sustain(.15).release(1.2)
  .lpf(1800).room(.6).size(.8).gain(.38)

// Right hand: a singing line; the last phrase of every four lifts an octave
right: note("<[f4@3 eb4 db4@2 eb4 f4] [db5@4 c5@2 bb4 ab4] [bb4@3 ab4 gb4@2 f4 eb4] [eb4@2 f4 gb4 f4@4]>")
  .s("sine").fm(.8).fmh(2)
  .attack(.01).decay(1.4).sustain(.2).release(1.5)
  .lastOf(4, x => x.add(12))
  .gain(.5)
  .off(1/16, x => x.add(12).gain(.12))
  .room(.65).size(.85)

// Rain on the window
rain: s("rain").slow(4).intensity(.4).gain(.28)

sketches.name: Clockwork Canon
sketches.description: A three-voice canon over a repeating ground. Every melody uses only chord tones of the same progression, so each delayed voice fits the one before it.

sketches.name: Phase Garden
sketches.description: Minimalism after Steve Reich: two pianos with figures of twelve and eleven notes drift apart and back, while one clapper rotates against another.
sketches.source:
setcpm(100/4)

// Two pianos play the same figure, but the second has dropped its last note,
// so it slides one step ahead of the first every cycle until they meet again
piano1: note("{e4 f#4 b4 c#5 d5 f#4 e4 c#5 b4 f#4 d5 c#5}%12")
  .s("triangle").timbre("bright").attack(.002).decay(.2).sustain(0).release(.2)
  .pan(.2).gain(.28)
piano2: note("{e4 f#4 b4 c#5 d5 f#4 e4 c#5 b4 f#4 d5}%12")
  .s("triangle").timbre("bright").attack(.002).decay(.2).sustain(0).release(.2)
  .pan(.8).gain(.28)

// A marimba of seven notes in six steps, drifting at its own speed
marimba: note("{b2 e3 f#3 b2 e3 c#3 d3}%6")
  .s("sine").fm(.6).fmh(4).decay(.35).sustain(0).room(.3).gain(.32)

// Clapping: one part holds still, the other rotates one step each cycle
clap1: s("cp cp cp ~ cp cp ~ cp ~ cp cp ~").pan(.35).gain(.3)
clap2: s("cp cp cp ~ cp cp ~ cp ~ cp cp ~").iter(12).speed(1.1).pan(.65).gain(.25)

sketches.name: Moon Lullaby
sketches.description: A music-box waltz in 3/4 with oom-pah-pah accompaniment, a parent humming along and crickets outside.

sketches.name: The Tempest
sketches.description: An eight-cycle cinematic storm in D minor: a power-fifth string ostinato descends while timpani, brass, choir and wind build to a climax.
sketches.source:
setcpm(90/4)

// Eight cycles: calm (1-2), gathering (3-4), storm (5-6), aftermath (7-8)

// Strings: a driving root-and-fifth ostinato stepping down D, C, Bb, A
strings: note("d3 d3 a3 d3 a2 d3 a3 d3").add("<0 0 -2 -2 -4 -4 -5 -5>")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(2).detune(.15)
  .attack(.01).decay(.12).sustain(.4).release(.08)
  .lpf(sine.range(800, 3000).slow(8)).room(.4).gain(.28)

// Brass: open, heroic chords that swell in with the filter
brass: note("<[d3,a3,d4] ~ [c3,g3,c4] ~ [bb2,f3,bb3] [bb2,f3,d4] [a2,e3,a3] [a2,e3,a3]>")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(.2)
  .lpf(900).lpenv(2.5).lpattack(.15)
  .attack(.15).release(1).room(.6).gain(.28)

// Timpani roll from a single stroke to thunder
timpani: s("<[lt ~ ~ ~] [lt ~ lt ~] [lt ~ lt lt] [lt lt lt [lt lt]] [bd ~ lt ~] [bd lt bd lt] [bd*2 lt*2] [lt*8]>")
  .speed(.7).lpf(900).room(.7).gain(.6)
cymbals: s("<~ ~ ~ ~ cr ~ ~ cr>").room(.8).gain(.4)

// The choir arrives with the storm
choir: note("<~ ~ ~ ~ [d4,f4,bb4] [d4,f4,bb4] [c#4,e4,a4] [c#4,e4,g4,a4]>")
  .s("choir").syl("ah").attack(.4).release(1.5).room(.7).gain(.35)

// Wind rises and falls across the whole arc
wind: s("pink").hpf(300).lpf(sine.range(400, 2500).slow(8))
  .gain("<.04 .06 .08 .12 .25 .3 .2 .08>").pan(sine.slow(3))

sketches.name: Midnight Bossa
sketches.description: Bossa nova on ii-V-I-VI: the clave on the rim, nylon-string comping, an upright bass on the dotted quarter and a breathy flute.
sketches.source:
setcpm(136/8)

// One cycle is two bars. Bossa clave on the rim, brushed shaker, soft surdo kick
perc: stack(
  s("rim ~ ~ rim ~ ~ rim ~ ~ ~ rim ~ ~ rim ~ ~").gain(.45),
  s("hh*16").hpf(6000).gain(saw.range(.12, .28).fast(8)),
  s("bd ~ ~ bd bd ~ ~ bd bd ~ ~ bd bd ~ ~ bd").lpf(260).gain(.55)
)

// Nylon-string comping: Dm9, G13, Cmaj9, A7b9
guitar: note("<[f3,a3,c4,e4] [f3,b3,e4,a4] [e3,g3,b3,d4] [g3,bb3,c#4,e4]>")
  .struct("~ ~ x ~ x ~ ~ x ~ ~ x ~ x ~ ~ x")
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft")
  .attack(.003).decay(.35).sustain(0).release(.3)
  .lpf(2400).pan(.4).room(.35).gain(.3)

// Upright bass: root on the dotted quarter, fifth on the and
bass: note("<[d2@3 a1]*4 [g1@3 d2]*4 [c2@3 g1]*4 [a1@3 e2]*4>")
  .s("sine").shape(.15).decay(.4).sustain(.3).release(.15).gain(.6)

// A breathy flute drifting over the changes
flute: note("<[e5@2 d5 c5 a4@3 ~] [f5@2 e5 d5 b4@3 ~] [e5@3 d5 b4@2 g4 a4] [bb4@2 a4 g4 c#5@3 ~]>")
  .s("sine").timbre("hollow")
  .vib(5).vibdepth(.12).attack(.05).sustain(.6).release(.4)
  .pan(.6).delay(.3).delaytime(3/16).room(.5).gain(.32)

sketches.name: Twelve-Bar Shuffle
sketches.description: A full twelve-bar blues in A: boogie bass, triplet ride, organ stabs on two and four and a crying harmonica.

sketches.name: Tango de Medianoche
sketches.description: Tango nuevo in D minor: bandoneon chords on the 3-3-2 rhythm, a marcato bass and a passionate violin.
sketches.source:
setcpm(116/4)

// Bandoneon chords on the 3-3-2: Dm, Gm, A7, Dm
bandoneon: note("<[d3,f3,a3] [d3,g3,bb3] [c#3,e3,g3,a3] [d3,f3,a3]>")
  .struct("x ~ ~ x ~ ~ x ~")
  .s("sawtooth").timbre("reed").unison(2).detune(.15)
  .attack(.01).decay(.2).sustain(.3).release(.1)
  .lpf(2000).pan(.4).gain(.3)

// Marcato bass with a chromatic climb home
bass: note("<[d2 ~ a1 ~ d2 ~ a1 ~] [g1 ~ d2 ~ g1 ~ d2 ~] [a1 ~ e2 ~ a1 ~ c#2 ~] [d2 ~ a1 ~ d2 [a1 bb1] [b1 c#2] d2]>")
  .s("triangle").attack(.003).decay(.2).sustain(.2).release(.1).gain(.55)

// The violin: long, aching notes and a flattened ninth over the A7
violin: note("<[a4@3 bb4 a4@2 g#4 a4] [d5@4 c5 bb4 a4 g4] [f4@2 e4 f4 g4@2 a4 bb4] [a4@6 ~@2]>")
  .s("sawtooth").vib(6).vibdepth(.2)
  .attack(.08).sustain(.7).release(.3)
  .lpf(3500).pan(.6).room(.5).gain(.28)

// Knocks on the body of the bandoneon
knocks: s("rim ~ ~ rim ~ ~ rim ~").lpf(1500).gain(.2)

sketches.name: Gamelan Garden
sketches.description: A Balinese-style gamelan in a pelog-like scale: a gong cycle, a balungan core melody and two kotekan parts that interlock into one shimmering line.
sketches.source:
setcpm(100/4)

// A pelog-flavoured scale: e f g b c
// The gong marks each four-cycle phrase
gong: note("<e2 ~ ~ ~>").s("sine").fm(1.4).fmh(1.41)
  .decay(4).sustain(0).release(4).room(.7).size(.9).gain(.45)

// Balungan: the core melody on the metallophones
balungan: note("<[e4 f4 g4 f4] [e4 c4 b3 e4] [g4 b4 c5 b4] [g4 f4 e4 ~]>")
  .s("sine").fm(2.2).fmh(3.5).decay(.9).sustain(0).release(1)
  .room(.5).gain(.35)

// Kotekan: polos and sangsih fill each other's gaps exactly
polos: note("e5 ~ f5 e5 ~ e5 ~ f5 e5 ~ f5 e5 ~ e5 ~ f5")
  .s("sine").fm(3).fmh(5.4).decay(.25).sustain(0).release(.3)
  .pan(.3).gain(.22)
sangsih: note("~ g5 ~ ~ g5 ~ b5 ~ ~ g5 ~ ~ g5 ~ b5 ~")
  .s("sine").fm(3).fmh(5.4).decay(.25).sustain(0).release(.3)
  .pan(.7).gain(.22)

// Kendang drums and the kempli time-keeper
kendang: s("lt ~ [~ lt] mt, ~ ~ ht ~, ~ rim ~ rim")
  .every(4, fast(2)).room(.3).gain(.4)

sketches.name: Kyoto Dawn
sketches.description: Koto plucks in the Japanese in scale, a gliding shakuhachi, a temple bell and water over stones.
sketches.source:
setcpm(60/4)

// Koto plucks in the in scale: d eb g a bb
koto: note("<[d4 eb4 g4 a4 bb4@2 a4 g4] [d5@2 bb4 a4 g4@2 eb4 d4] [a3 bb3 d4 eb4 g4@3 ~] [eb4 d4 bb3 a3 d4@4]>")
  .s("triangle").timbre("bright")
  .attack(.002).decay(.5).sustain(0).release(.6)
  .pan(.35).delay(.25).delaytime(3/8).room(.6).gain(.38)

// Shakuhachi: long breathy notes that bend between pitches
flute: note("<a4 [g4@3 eb4] d4 ~ bb4 [a4@3 g4] a4 ~>")
  .s("sine").timbre("hollow").mono(1).glide(.15)
  .vib(4.5).vibdepth(.25).attack(.3).sustain(.7).release(1.2)
  .pan(.65).room(.8).size(.9).gain(.32)

// A low open fifth and a distant temple bell
drone: note("[d2,a2]").slow(4).s("sine").attack(2).sustain(1).release(3).gain(.2)
bell: note("<d3 ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~>").s("sine").fm(3).fmh(2.76)
  .decay(4).sustain(0).release(4).room(.9).size(.95).gain(.22)

// Water over stones
stream: s("stream").slow(4).gain(.25)

sketches.name: Desert Caravan
sketches.description: E Phrygian dominant: maqsum on the darbuka, an oud riff, an ornamented ney flute and hot wind across the dunes.
sketches.source:
setcpm(104/4)

// Maqsum on the darbuka: doum on the low drum, tek on the rim
darbuka: s("lt rim ~ rim lt ~ rim ~")
  .sometimesBy(.25, x => x.ply(2))
  .lpf(2500).room(.3).gain(.55)
fingers: s("hh*16?0.35").hpf(5000).gain(.18)

// A reedy drone on E and B
drone: note("[e2,b2]").s("sawtooth").timbre("reed")
  .lpf(700).attack(.4).sustain(1).release(1).gain(.22)

// Oud riff in E Phrygian dominant: e f g# a b c d
oud: note("<[e3 f3 g#3 a3 b3 a3 g#3 f3] [e3 ~ e3 f3 e3 d3 e3 ~] [a3 b3 c4 b3 a3 g#3 f3 g#3] [f3 e3 d3 f3 e3@4]>")
  .s("triangle").timbre("bright")
  .attack(.002).decay(.3).sustain(0).release(.2)
  .pan(.4).gain(.38)

// Ney flute, ornamented with glides
ney: note("<[b4@3 c5 b4@2 a4 g#4] [a4@4 g#4 f4 e4@2] [e5@2 d5 c5 b4@3 a4] [g#4 a4 g#4 f4 e4@4]>")
  .s("sine").timbre("reed").vowel("o")
  .mono(1).glide(.07).vib(5).vibdepth(.25)
  .attack(.06).sustain(.7).release(.4)
  .pan(.6).delay(.3).delaytime(3/8).room(.6).gain(.3)

// Hot wind across the dunes
wind: s("wind").slow(8).gain(.14)

sketches.name: Highland Jig
sketches.description: A jig in true 6/8: a fiddle tune in D with a tin whistle doubling, bodhran, guitar and pipe drones.
sketches.source:
setcpm(116/2)

// One cycle is a bar of 6/8: two groups of three
// Fiddle tune in D, doubled by a tin whistle every other bar
fiddle: note("<[d4 f#4 a4 d5 a4 f#4] [g4 b4 d5 b4 a4 g4] [f#4 a4 d5 e5 f#5 e5] [d5 b4 a4 [f#4 e4] d4 ~]>")
  .s("sawtooth").timbre("reed").lpf(3200)
  .vib(6).vibdepth(.12).attack(.02).decay(.2).sustain(.5).release(.1)
  .gain(.32)
  .every(2, x => x.superimpose(y => y.add(12).s("sine").gain(.14)))

// Bodhran: lift on the first of each three
bodhran: s("lt ~ lt lt ~ lt, ~ ~ ~ mt ~ ~").lpf(1200).room(.3).gain(.5)

// Guitar in the jig rhythm
guitar: note("<[d3,f#3,a3] [g3,b3,d4] [d3,f#3,a3] [a2,c#3,e3,g3]>")
  .struct("x ~ x x ~ x").s("triangle")
  .attack(.003).decay(.2).sustain(0).release(.15).pan(.35).gain(.28)

// Pipe drones under everything
drones: note("[d2,a2,d3]").s("sawtooth").timbre("reed")
  .lpf(900).attack(.2).sustain(1).release(.5).gain(.16)

sketches.name: Lagos Engine
sketches.description: Afrobeat: a bell pattern, shekere, a restless bass, two interlocking guitars and a horn section's call and answer.
sketches.source:
setcpm(112/4)

// The bell holds the whole band together
bell: s("rim").struct("x ~ x ~ x x ~ x ~ x ~ x x ~ x ~").hpf(1500).gain(.35)
shekere: s("hh*16").hpf(6000).gain(sine.range(.12, .3).fast(4))

// Kit: syncopated kick, backbeat snare, open hats on the off-beats
drums: s("bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~ bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ bd ~, ~ ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ sd?0.3 ~ ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~, ~ ~ oh ~ ~ ~ oh ~ ~ ~ oh ~ ~ ~ oh ~")
  .gain(.65)

// A bass line that never stops moving
bass: note("e2 ~ ~ e2 ~ g2 ~ a2 ~ ~ e2 ~ d2 ~ b1 d2")
  .s("sawtooth").lpf(700).lpq(3).decay(.2).sustain(.4).release(.08).gain(.5)

// Two guitars locking together: one scratchy, one picking
scratch: note("[~ e4 ~ e4 ~ [e4 g4] ~ e4]*2")
  .s("square").pw(.2).hpf(800).decay(.08).sustain(0).pan(.3).gain(.18)
pick: note("b3 d4 e4 ~ b3 d4 ~ g4 b3 d4 e4 ~ a3 ~ b3 d4")
  .s("triangle").timbre("bright").decay(.12).sustain(0).pan(.7).gain(.24)

// Horn section: a call, then the answer
horns: note("<[~@3 [g4,b4,e5] ~ [g4,b4,e5] ~@2] [~@3 [a4,d5,f#5]@2 [g4,b4,e5]@3]>")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(2).detune(.1)
  .lpf(1200).lpenv(2).lpattack(.03).lpdecay(.2)
  .attack(.02).release(.15).room(.3).gain(.28)

sketches.name: Evening Raga
sketches.description: Raga Yaman at dusk: a ringing tanpura, sitar phrases that climb ni re ga and fall home to sa, and tabla.
sketches.source:
setcpm(72/4)

// Raga Yaman: the lydian colour of the raised fourth
// Tanpura: pa, sa, sa, low sa, ringing on and on
tanpura: note("g2 c3 c3 c2").slow(2).s("sawtooth").timbre("bright")
  .unison(2).detune(.08).attack(.01).decay(2).sustain(.4).release(2.5)
  .lpf(1800).room(.6).gain(.22)

// Sitar: phrases that climb ni re ga, then fall back home
sitar: n("<[-1 1 2@2 1 2 3@2] [4@4 3 2 1 2] [3 4 5 6 7@2 6 5] [4 3 2 1 0@4]>")
  .scale("C:lydian").transpose(12)
  .s("sawtooth").timbre("bright").mono(1).glide(.1)
  .vib(6).vibdepth(.15).penv(1).pdecay(.03)
  .attack(.003).decay(.5).sustain(.4).release(.3)
  .lpf(3500).pan(.55).room(.5).gain(.28)

// Tabla: bayan below, dayan and rim above
tabla: s("lt ht [~ ht] ht, ~ ~ rim ~, ~ [~ lt] ~ ~")
  .speed(1.2).sometimesBy(.2, x => x.ply(2)).room(.3).gain(.42)

sketches.name: Neon Boulevard
sketches.description: Synthwave: gated drums, a pumping octave bass, a big detuned pad, a sequenced arpeggio and a lead that arrives after four bars.
sketches.source:
setcpm(100/4)

// Gated drums: four on the floor, a huge snare and pumping hats
drums: stack(
  s("bd*4").shape(.2).gain(.8),
  s("~ sd ~ sd").room(.6).size(.85).gain(.55),
  s("hh*8").hpf(7000).gain(saw.range(.15, .35).fast(4))
)

// Driving eighth-note bass through Am, F, C, G with an octave echo
bass: note("<a1 f1 c2 g1>").ply(8)
  .s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.range(400, 1400).slow(16)).lpq(4).lpenv(2).lpdecay(.1)
  .decay(.15).sustain(.3).release(.05).gain(.45)
  .off(1/16, x => x.add(12).gain(.2))

// A wide pad holding the chords
pad: note("<[a3,c4,e4] [f3,a3,c4] [c4,e4,g4] [g3,b3,d4]>")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(4).detune(.3)
  .attack(.4).release(1.5).lpf(1800).room(.7).gain(.22)

// Sequenced arpeggio following the roots
arp: n("[0 2 4 7]*2").add("<0 5 2 6>").scale("A:minor").transpose(12)
  .s("square").pw(.3).decay(.08).sustain(0)
  .delay(.4).delaytime(3/16).delayfeedback(.45).gain(.18)

// The lead enters on the fifth bar
lead: n("<[11@3 9 7@2 9 11] [12@4 11 9@3] [11@3 13 11@2 9@2] [10@4 8@2 ~@2]>")
  .scale("A:minor").mask("<0 0 0 0 1 1 1 1>")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(2).detune(.15).mono(1).glide(.06)
  .vib(5).vibdepth(.15).lpf(2800)
  .delay(.35).delaytime(3/8).room(.5).gain(.28)

sketches.name: Rainy Window
sketches.description: Lo-fi study beats: dusty swung drums, descending Rhodes sevenths, a sleepy glass melody, vinyl crackle and rain.
sketches.source:
setcpm(78/4)

// Dusty swung drums, bit-reduced and rolled off
drums: s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~, ~ sd ~ sd, hh*8")
  .swing(4).crush(9).lpf(3500).gain(.65)

// Rhodes sevenths sliding down: Fmaj7, Em7, Dm7, Cmaj7
keys: note("<[f3,a3,c4,e4] [e3,g3,b3,d4] [d3,f3,a3,c4] [c3,e3,g3,b3]>")
  .struct("x ~ ~ [~ x] ~ ~ x ~")
  .s("sine").fm(1.1).fmh(2).trem(4).tremdepth(.25)
  .decay(.8).sustain(.3).release(.6).lpf(2200).room(.4).gain(.36)

// Round sub bass
bass: note("<f2 e2 d2 c2>").struct("x ~ ~ x ~ [~ x] ~ ~")
  .s("sine").shape(.1).decay(.5).sustain(.3).release(.3).gain(.6)

// A sleepy glass melody that forgets a note now and then
melody: n("~ [4 ~ 3] ~ 2 ~ ~ [0 1] ~").scale("A:minor pentatonic").transpose(12)
  .every(4, rev)
  .degradeBy(.2).seed("study")
  .s("triangle").timbre("glass").decay(.4).sustain(0).release(.8)
  .delay(.4).delaytime(3/8).delayfeedback(.4).room(.5).gain(.3)

// Vinyl crackle and rain outside
crackle: s("click*16?0.3").hpf(3000).gain(rand.range(.03, .1))
rain: s("rain").slow(4).intensity(.3).gain(.2)

sketches.name: Sunday Deep House
sketches.description: Dorian chord stabs through a breathing filter, warm sub bass, a ticking kit and an answering vocal 'ooh'.
sketches.source:
setcpm(122/4)

// Kit: kick, off-beat open hat, clap and ticking sixteenths
drums: stack(
  s("bd*4").gain(.8),
  s("[~ oh]*4").gain(.35),
  s("~ cp ~ cp").room(.3).gain(.5),
  s("hh*16").hpf(8000).gain(perlin.range(.08, .25))
)

// Dorian stabs, Cm9 to F9, through a breathing filter
stabs: note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3,d4] [eb3,g3,a3,c4,f4]>")
  .struct("~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ x ~ ~")
  .s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.range(600, 2200).slow(8)).lpq(4)
  .decay(.25).sustain(0).release(.2)
  .delay(.3).delaytime(3/16).delayfeedback(.35).room(.4).gain(.28)

// Warm sub bass
bass: note("<[c2 ~ ~ c2 ~ ~ bb1 ~] [f1 ~ ~ f1 ~ ~ eb2 ~]>")
  .s("sine").shape(.2).decay(.3).sustain(.5).release(.1).gain(.6)

// A vocal 'ooh' answering the chords
vox: note("<[~ g4 ~ ~ bb4 ~ ~ ~] [~ a4 ~ ~ c5 ~ ~ ~]>")
  .s("ooh").attack(.05).release(.6)
  .delay(.4).delaytime(3/8).room(.5).gain(.28)

sketches.name: Liquid Horizon
sketches.description: Liquid drum and bass: a two-step break with ghost notes, a detuned reese, lush pads, Rhodes arpeggios in the delay and a distant voice.
sketches.source:
setcpm(174/4)

// Two-step break with ghost snares
drums: stack(
  s("bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~, ~ ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ sd?0.3 ~ ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ sd?0.2").gain(.8),
  s("hh*16?0.25").hpf(8000).gain(.3),
  s("[~ rd]*4").gain(.2)
)

// Reese bass: detuned saws under a slow filter
reese: note("<e1 e1 c1 d1>").s("sawtooth").unison(4).detune(.4)
  .lpf(sine.range(200, 700).slow(4)).lpq(3)
  .attack(.05).sustain(1).release(.3).gain(.38)

// Lush pads: Em7, Em7, Cmaj7, Dadd9
pads: note("<[e3,g3,b3,d4] [e3,g3,b3,d4] [c3,e3,g3,b3] [d3,f#3,a3,e4]>")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(.2)
  .attack(.6).release(1.8).lpf(1600).room(.8).size(.9).gain(.18)

// Rhodes arpeggios bouncing through the delay
keys: n("0 2 4 6 7 6 4 2").add("<0 0 -2 -1>").scale("E:minor").transpose(12)
  .s("sine").fm(1).fmh(2).decay(.25).sustain(0)
  .pan(sine.slow(4)).delay(.45).delaytime(3/16).delayfeedback(.5).gain(.22)

// A distant voice
vox: note("<b4 ~ a4 [g4 f#4]>").s("ooh").attack(.4).release(2).room(.8).gain(.22)

sketches.name: Midnight Trap Lantern
sketches.description: Half-time trap: rolling hi-hats, a gliding 808 that slides between notes, a dark FM bell and a choir pad.
sketches.source:
setcpm(140/4)

// Half-time kit: the clap lands on beat three
drums: s("bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~, ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ [cp,sd] ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~")
  .room(.2).gain(.75)

// Hi-hats that roll into triplets and thirty-seconds
hats: s("hh*8").sometimesBy(.35, x => x.ply("<2 3 4>"))
  .hpf(6000).pan(sine.range(.4, .6)).gain(.32)

// The 808: a mono sine that glides between notes
b808: note("<[c2@6 c2 ~ eb2@4 ~ ~ g1@2] [ab1@6 ab1 ~ g1@6 bb1@2] [f1@6 f1 ~ ab1@4 ~ ~ c2@2] [g1@8 g1 ~ ~ g1 b1@2 d2@2]>")
  .s("sine").mono(1).glide(.08).shape(.3)
  .attack(.005).decay(1).sustain(.6).release(.2).gain(.55)

// A dark FM bell melody
bell: n("<[0 ~ 3 ~ 2 ~ 0 ~] [~ 4 ~ 3 2 ~ ~ ~]>").scale("C:minor").transpose(12)
  .s("sine").fm(2).fmh(3).decay(.4).sustain(0)
  .delay(.3).delaytime(3/16).room(.5).gain(.24)

// A choir pad: Cm, Ab, Fm, G
pad: note("<[c3,eb3,g3] [ab2,c3,eb3] [f2,ab2,c3] [g2,b2,d3]>")
  .s("ooh").attack(.5).release(1.5).room(.6).gain(.2)

sketches.name: Funk Machine
sketches.description: E dorian funk: a tight kit with ghost notes, a snapping bass, an auto-wah clavinet and horn punches on every fourth bar.
sketches.source:
setcpm(104/4)

// Tight kit with ghost notes on the snare and accented hats
drums: stack(
  s("bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ ~ bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~, ~ ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ sd?0.3 ~ sd?0.25 ~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~").gain(.75),
  s("hh*16").hpf(7000).gain("[.35 .15]*8")
)

// Snapping bass with a filter pluck
bass: note("e2 ~ e3 ~ ~ e2 g2 ~ a2 ~ ~ e2 ~ d3 b2 ~")
  .s("sawtooth").lpf(900).lpenv(2.5).lpdecay(.08)
  .decay(.15).sustain(.2).release(.05).gain(.55)

// Clavinet through an auto-wah: Em7 and A7 shapes
clav: note("~ [g3,b3,d4] ~ [g3,b3,d4] [g3,b3,d4] ~ ~ [g3,b3,d4] ~ [g3,c#4,e4] ~ [g3,b3,d4] ~ ~ [g3,c#4,e4] ~")
  .s("square").pw(.2).lpf(sine.range(800, 3000).fast(2)).lpq(8)
  .attack(.002).decay(.08).sustain(0).pan(.35).gain(.2)

// Horn punches on every fourth bar
horns: note("<~ ~ ~ [~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ [b4,e5] [b4,e5] ~ [c#5,e5] ~ [d5,g5] ~ [e5,a5]@3]>")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(2).detune(.1)
  .lpf(1500).lpenv(2).lpattack(.02).lpdecay(.15)
  .attack(.01).release(.1).pan(.65).room(.3).gain(.3)

sketches.name: 8-Bit Quest
sketches.description: A chiptune adventure theme: pulse-wave hero melody, fast broken chords, an octave-jumping triangle bass and noise-channel drums.
sketches.source:
setcpm(150/4)

// Hero theme on a pulse wave
lead: note("<[c5 ~ g4 c5 e5 ~ d5 c5] [d5 ~ b4 g4 d5 ~ f5 e5] [e5 g5 e5 c5 a4 ~ c5 e5] [d5 c5 b4 g4 c5@3 ~]>")
  .s("square").pw(.25).decay(.1).sustain(.6).release(.05)
  .vib(6).vibdepth(.05).gain(.2)

// Fast broken-chord harmony: C, G, Am, G
arp: note("<[c4 e4 g4 e4]*2 [b3 d4 g4 d4]*2 [a3 c4 e4 c4]*2 [b3 d4 g4 d4]*2>")
  .s("square").pw(.5).decay(.05).sustain(0).pan(.35).gain(.11)

// Triangle bass jumping octaves
bass: note("<[c2 c3]*4 [g1 g2]*4 [a1 a2]*4 [g1 g2]*4>")
  .s("triangle").decay(.1).sustain(.5).release(.05).gain(.5)

// Noise-channel drums, with a fill every fourth bar
kick: note("c2 ~ [~ c2] ~").s("sine").penv(30).pdecay(.04).decay(.15).sustain(0).gain(.6)
snare: s("~ white ~ white").hpf(2000).decay(.1).sustain(0).gain(.25)
  .every(4, x => x.ply(2))
hats: s("white*8").hpf(9000).decay(.02).sustain(0).gain(.1)

sketches.name: Cathedral of Light
sketches.description: A choir breathes slow D minor chords while a lone voice sings 'Ave Maria, gratia plena' over organ pedals, bells and an overtone hum.
sketches.source:
setcpm(56/4)

// A choir breathing slow chords in D minor
choir: note("<[d3,a3,f4] [bb2,f3,d4] [g2,d3,bb3] [a2,e3,c#4]>").slow(2)
  .s("choir").syl("<ah oh oo ah>")
  .attack(1.5).release(3).space("church").gain(.38)

// A single voice sings above it: a-ve ma-ri-a, gra-ti-a ple-na
solo: note("<a4 [bb4 a4] g4 [f4 e4] d4 ~ e4 [f4 g4]>")
  .s("voice").syl("<a [ve ma] ri [a gra] ti ~ a [ple na]>")
  .voicetype("alto").mono(1).vglide(.1)
  .attack(.2).release(1).space("church").gain(.4)

// Organ pedal notes underneath
pedal: note("<d2 bb1 g1 a1>").slow(2).s("sawtooth").timbre("organ")
  .lpf(500).attack(1).release(3).gain(.28)

// Distant bells and an overtone hum
bells: note("<d5 ~ a4 ~ ~ f5 ~ ~>").s("sine").fm(3.5).fmh(2.41)
  .decay(3).sustain(0).release(3).space("church").gain(.15)
hum: note("d2").slow(8).s("hum").overtone(6).gain(.2)

sketches.name: Forest Morning
sketches.description: Headphones on: a stream, birds placed around you, insects near the ground, a distant woodpecker and a pastoral flute with harp.
sketches.source:
setcpm(80/4)

// A stream and a light breeze set the scene
stream: s("stream").slow(4).gain(.28)
breeze: s("wind").slow(8).intensity(.3).gain(.1)

// Birds placed around the listener: one ahead-left, one circling high on the right
robin: s("bird").slow(2).azimuth(-40).distance(3).gain(.45)
lark: s("bird").slow(3).azimuth(saw.range(30, 150).slow(6)).elevation(30).distance(5).posglide(.3).gain(.35)

// Insects close to the ground, a woodpecker far off
insects: s("insect").slow(4).azimuth(100).distance(2).gain(.14)
woodpecker: s("rim*6?0.6 ~ ~ ~").mask("<0 1 0 0>").speed(2).lpf(3000).azimuth(70).distance(6).gain(.22)

// A wooden flute plays a pastoral tune over a harp
flute: note("<[g4@2 a4 b4 d5@3 b4] [c5@2 b4 a4 g4@4] [e4 g4 a4 b4 a4@2 g4 e4] [d4@6 ~@2]>")
  .s("sine").timbre("hollow").vib(5).vibdepth(.15)
  .attack(.06).sustain(.6).release(.5)
  .delay(.25).delaytime(3/8).room(.6).gain(.32)
harp: note("<[g3 b3 d4 b3] [c4 e4 g4 e4] [e3 g3 b3 g3] [d3 f#3 a3 f#3]>")
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft").decay(.4).sustain(0).release(.5).room(.5).gain(.22)

sketches.name: Orbital Station
sketches.description: Headphones on: a binaural drone through the hull, a slowly opening pad, telemetry blips, engines behind you and crackling radio chatter.
sketches.source:
setcpm(70/4)

// A binaural drone hums through the hull
drone: note("<c2 c2 ab1 bb1>").slow(2).s("sine").binaural(4)
  .attack(2).sustain(1).release(3).gain(.4)

// Wide, slowly opening pad
pad: note("[c3,g3,d4,eb4]").slow(4).s("sawtooth").unison(4).detune(.35)
  .lpf(sine.range(300, 1200).slow(16)).attack(3).release(4).room(.8).size(.95).gain(.15)

// Telemetry: random blips from a pentatonic computer
blips: n(irand(10).segment(16)).scale("C:minor pentatonic").transpose(24)
  .degradeBy(.6).seed("orbit")
  .s("sine").decay(.05).sustain(0).release(.05)
  .pan(rand).delay(.3).delaytime(1/8).delayfeedback(.4).gain(.18)

// The station's engines, somewhere behind you
engine: s("engine").slow(8).azimuth(180).distance(3).gain(.25)

// Crackling radio chatter and an airlock cycling
radio: s("whisper*4?0.4").syl("<sha ko ta ri>").crush(5).hpf(900).pan(.8).gain(.14)
airlock: s("white").slow(8).hpf(sine.range(200, 5000).slow(8)).gain(.05)
